name: Georgia Aquarium
tagline: Whale sharks, belugas, and giant ocean windows — Atlanta’s kid wow tank.

practical.ticket_note: Timed tickets often sell out on weekends — book ahead.

items.label: Shark
items.one_liner: Home of the whale sharks — look for the biggest fish in the tank.

qa_card.question: Which fish looks the biggest?
qa_card.answer: Whale sharks are the biggest fish in the world — gentle giants!
